approval_required_for: Reorder functional_sim before case_board_interface_discovery or before case_axi_ddr_interface
Promote case_vivado_synthesis, case_vivado_implementation, case_runtime_bitstream, or board_runtime before current verification closure evidence
Change Transformer-block-only scope or golden boundaries to include embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, or sampling
Make a major change to board memory layout, runtime config, AXI address map, or numeric tolerance derived from DUT output
Accept a board target discovery guess without cited sample-project or Vivado evidence

executable_actions.on_failure: If gate order, downstream/backend separation, exact sample-wrapper identity, or Transformer-block-only scope fails a current-stage static check, edit the DAG/gate contract within planner authority and rerun; do not promote an invalid refinement.
executable_actions.rationale: Run current-stage static planning checkers over the refined layer-3 DAG to bind gate order, exact-wrapper identity, Transformer-block-only scope, and downstream backend separation before auditor handoff.

executable_actions.on_failure: If the audit finds missing evidence binding, downstream gate leakage, or out-of-scope claims, return the DAG/gate map to this planner for bounded correction before any auditor promotion.
executable_actions.rationale: Run the verification action auditor against the validated DAG and hand off checker-grounded evidence to verification_artifacts.verification_dag_auditor so a peer role validates the planner output instead of self-certifying.

executable_actions.on_failure: If SACG memory update fails or fails sacg_memory_check, keep the stage handoff blocked and rerun the memory update after correcting the stage summary or artifact references.
executable_actions.rationale: Record the refined DAG outcome and preserved downstream gate declarations in shared SACG memory so later stages consume the planner decision, risks, and audit evidence.

observations: The current candidate verification_artifact_contract is present and its checker_summary reports no current-stage errors; tool_protocol_check, human_boundary_check, hierarchical_verification_plan_check, verification_artifact_contract_check, required_real_tool_evidence_check, and data_order_trace_check pass at static planning scope.

The layer-3 DAG order matches the role assignment: case_board_interface_discovery and case_multilayer_pipeline precede case_axi_ddr_interface and functional_sim, followed by case_multilayer_functional, case_pipeline_deadlock_check, case_axi_protocol_check, case_ddr_image_roundtrip, and case_board_semantic_evidence.

Vivado synthesis/implementation, runtime bitstream, runtime ABI, and board_runtime are declared as downstream nodes after board bring-up readiness and are not promoted as current verifier responsibilities.

The existing case_vcs_functional_sim tool mode is compile-only VCS compilation/elaboration/linking evidence for the exact discovered board wrapper; simulator execution, runtime weight loading, golden comparison, and waveform/numerical outputs are not verification acceptance prerequisites.

sacg_memory_truth shows zero active contamination barriers, zero open retry requests, and zero open backtrack requests; hierarchical_learning_context has no validated lower-layer certificates, so lower-layer verification remains a downstream execution obligation rather than a current DAG plan blocker.

The DAG preserves Transformer-block-only accelerator scope and excludes embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, and sampling from DUT implementation, weight coverage, and golden boundaries.
Board interface discovery must synthesize the target discovery contract from supplied sample-project/Vivado evidence; framework-core actions must not hardcode model, board, module, or path names.
proposed_actions: Promote the refined board AXI/DDR DAG only after current-stage static validators pass and downstream backend gates remain after verification closure.
Keep case_board_interface_discovery as a mandatory predecessor to case_multilayer_pipeline and case_axi_ddr_interface.

Bind case_multilayer_functional, case_pipeline_deadlock_check, case_axi_protocol_check, case_ddr_image_roundtrip, and case_board_semantic_evidence to functional_sim evidence with required trace-related checker roles.
Declare Vivado synthesis, implementation, runtime bitstream, runtime ABI, and board_runtime as later-stage obligations and make no current-stage pass claim for them.
Hand off checker-grounded outputs to verification_artifacts.verification_dag_auditor instead of self-certifying the DAG.
risks: If case_board_interface_discovery guesses compute-slot, AXI, clock/reset, or calibration names before cited sample-project/Vivado evidence, the downstream exact wrapper identity can be wrong.

If functional_sim is treated as runtime numerical acceptance instead of the compile-only VCS acceptance mode, the gate could be prematurely promoted without current-source compile/elaborate/link evidence.

Derived checks such as data_order_trace_check, transfer_count_check, addr_map_check, and deadlock_watchdog depend on functional_sim instrumentation/trace evidence; missing trace fields would leave them not_run rather than pass.

Missing operator-leaf and single-layer promotion certificates are not current-stage blockers under stage_gate_policy, but they become mandatory Stage7 bottom-up execution obligations before board closure.
Cross-layer consistency risk remains between Stage5 memory/runtime layout and the exact discovered AXI/DDR wrapper image layout; it must be reconciled after case_board_interface_discovery.
Any tolerance or golden-boundary change derived from DUT output, or any expansion of DUT scope beyond Transformer blocks, would require approval and reversion.

edges: case_board_bringup_ready -> case_vivado_synthesis -> case_vivado_implementation -> case_runtime_bitstream -> case_runtime_abi_check -> board_runtime

output.summary: Refined the layer-3 board AXI/DDR verification DAG with the required order: board interface discovery -> multilayer pipeline -> AXI/DDR interface -> functional_sim -> derived multilayer/deadlock/AXI/DDR-image classifiers -> board semantic evidence. Vivado synthesis/implementation, runtime bitstream, runtime ABI, and board_runtime remain declared as downstream gates after verification closure and are not claimed in this stage.
